title.raw: 卷12 孝静紀 Volume 12 Annals: (Emperor) Xiaojing

sentences.zh: 孝靜皇帝，諱善見，清河文宣王亶之世子也，母曰胡妃。

translations.literal: Xiaojing Emperor bore the taboo name Shanjian; he was the heir of Prince Wenxuan of Qinghe, Dan; his mother was Consort Hu.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaojing Emperor bore the taboo name Shanjian. He was heir to Prince Wenxuan of Qinghe, Dan; his mother was Lady Hu.

sentences.zh: 永熙三年，拜通直散騎侍郎，八月，為驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongxi he was appointed direct-palace scattered cavalier attendant; in the eighth month he was made general of agile cavalry, opening-office equal-to-three-division commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yongxi he became direct-palace scattered cavalier attendant; in the eighth month he was made general of agile cavalry with an opening office equal in honor to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 出帝既入關，齊獻武王奉迎不克，乃與百僚會議，推帝以奉肅宗之後，時年十一。

translations.literal: When the emperor who had gone west had entered the passes, Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) went to welcome him but could not succeed; he then met with the hundred officials in council and set up the emperor to continue the line after Emperor Suzong—he was eleven years old.
translations.idiomatic: After the western-departing emperor entered the passes, Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) tried to welcome him back and failed. He then convened the ministers and enthroned the boy to carry on the line of Emperor Suzong—eleven years old.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙寅，即位于城東北，大赦天下，改永熙三年為天平元年。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day bingyin: he took the throne in the northeast of the city, granted a general amnesty to all under Heaven, and changed the third year of Yongxi to the first year of Tianping.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day in the tenth month of winter he was enthroned in the northeast of the city, amnestied the realm, and renamed the third year of Yongxi the first year of Tianping.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以太師、趙郡王諶為大司馬，以司空、咸陽王坦為太尉，以開府儀同三司高盛為司徒，以開府儀同三司高昂為司空。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Grand Preceptor, Prince of Zhao Commandery Chen was made grand marshal; Minister of Works, Prince of Xianyang Tan was made grand commander; opening-office equal-to-three-division commander Gao Sheng was made minister over the masses; opening-office equal-to-three-division commander Gao Ang was made minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Grand Preceptor Chen, prince of Zhao commandery, became grand marshal; Minister of Works Tan, prince of Xianyang, became grand commander; Gao Sheng and Gao Ang, both opening-office equals to the Three Excellencies, became minister over the masses and minister of works.

sentences.zh: 壬申，有事于太廟。

translations.literal: Day renshen: there was a service at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day the court performed rites at the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「安安能遷，自古之明典；

translations.literal: An edict said: "Settled settlement can yet be moved—an enlightened canon since antiquity;
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "A settled people may still be moved—that is an enlightened rule from antiquity;

sentences.zh: 所居靡定，往昔之成規。

translations.literal: dwelling without fixed abode was a settled practice of former ages.
translations.idiomatic: and to dwell without a fixed seat was a settled practice of former ages.

sentences.zh: 是以殷遷八城，周卜三地。

translations.literal: Therefore the Yin moved through eight cities and the Zhou divined three sites.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the Yin shifted among eight cities and the Zhou divined three sites.

sentences.zh: 吉凶有數，隆替無恒。

translations.literal: Fortune and misfortune have their measure; rise and decline have no constancy.
translations.idiomatic: Fortune and misfortune have their measure; rise and decline know no constancy.

sentences.zh: 事由於變通，理出於不得已故也。

translations.literal: Matters arise from change and adaptation; principle comes from what cannot be avoided.
translations.idiomatic: Matters arise from change and adaptation; principle comes from what cannot be avoided.

sentences.zh: 高祖孝文皇帝式觀乾象，俯協人謀，發自武州，來幸嵩縣，魏雖舊國，其命惟新。

translations.literal: Grand Ancestor Emperor Xiaowen observed the signs of Heaven and bowed to human counsel; he set out from Wuzhou and came to Song county—though Wei was an old realm, its mandate was made new.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Ancestor Emperor Xiaowen read the signs of Heaven and bowed to human counsel; he set out from Wuzhou and came to Song county—Wei was an old state, but its mandate was made new.

sentences.zh: 及正光之季，國步孔棘，喪亂不已，寇賊交侵，俾我生民，無所措手。

translations.literal: By the end of Zhengguang the state's steps were perilously narrow; mourning and disorder did not cease, bandits and enemies invaded together, so that our living people had nowhere to set hand or foot.
translations.idiomatic: By the end of Zhengguang the throne was in dire straits; mourning and disorder never ceased, and raiders pressed from every side, until the people had nowhere to turn.

sentences.zh: 今遠遵古式，深驗時事，考龜襲吉，遷宅漳滏。

translations.literal: Now, far following the ancient pattern and deeply testing present affairs, we have divined the tortoise and inherited good fortune: the capital is moved to the Zhang and Fen rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Now, following the ancient pattern and testing the times, we have divined the tortoise and taken good fortune—the capital moves to the Zhang and Fen rivers.

sentences.zh: 庶克隆洪基，再昌寶曆。

translations.literal: May we thereby further found the great foundation and again make the imperial calendar flourish.
translations.idiomatic: May we thereby enlarge the great foundation and make the imperial calendar flourish again.

sentences.zh: 主者明為條格，及時發邁。

translations.literal: Let those in charge set out regulations clearly and set out on the road in good time.
translations.idiomatic: Let the responsible offices draw up rules clearly and set out on the road in good time.

sentences.zh: 」丙子，車駕北遷于鄴。

translations.literal: " Day bingzi: the imperial carriage moved the capital north to Ye.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the imperial carriage moved the capital north to Ye.

sentences.zh: 詔齊獻武王留後部分。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) to remain behind and divide the host.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) to stay behind and divide the forces.

sentences.zh: 改司州為洛州，以衞大將軍、尚書令元弼為驃騎大將軍、儀同三司、洛州刺史，鎮洛陽。

translations.literal: Si Province was renamed Luo Province; Defender of the Realm, Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Bi was made general of agile cavalry, equal-to-three-division commander, and regional inspector of Luo, garrisoning Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Si province was renamed Luo province; Yuan Bi, defender of the realm and director of the Masters of Writing, was made general of agile cavalry, equal-to-three-division commander, and inspector of Luo, to garrison Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 詔從遷之戶，百官給復三年，安居人五年。

translations.literal: An edict: households that followed the move and the hundred officials were granted tax remission for three years; settled residents for five years.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted three years' tax remission to households that moved with the court and to officials, and five years to residents who stayed put.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月，寶炬渭州刺史可朱渾道元擁部來降，齊獻武王迎納之，賑其廩食。

translations.literal: Second year, first month of spring: Baoju's inspector of Wei Prefecture Kezhun Hun Daoyuan led his command in surrender; Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) received and settled them and relieved their grain stores.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, first month of spring, Kezhun Hun Daoyuan, inspector of Wei under Baoju, led his command in surrender; Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) received them, settled them, and opened the granaries.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔以齊獻武王為相國，假黃鉞，劍履上殿，入朝不趨，餘悉如故。

translations.literal: Day jisi: an edict made Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) grand chancellor, with borrowed yellow battle-axe, sword and shoes in the hall, and no need to hurry in court audience; the rest remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day an edict made Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) grand chancellor, lending the yellow battle-axe, permission to wear sword and shoes in the hall, and exemption from hurrying at audience; other honors stood unchanged.

sentences.zh: 王固讓不受。

translations.literal: The prince firmly declined and did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: The prince firmly declined and would not accept.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，兼尚書右僕射、東南道行臺元晏討元慶和，破走之。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Concurrent Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Southeastern-route grand mobile office Yuan Yan campaigned against Yuan Qinghe, defeated him, and put him to flight.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Yuan Yan, concurrent vice director and southeastern-route grand mobile office, campaigned against Yuan Qinghe, routed him, and drove him off.

sentences.zh: 二月壬午，以太尉、咸陽王坦為太傅，以司州牧、西河王悰為太尉。

translations.literal: Second month, day renwu: Grand Commander, Prince of Xianyang Tan was made grand preceptor; Regional Inspector of Si Province, Prince of Xihe Cong was made grand commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renwu day, Tan, prince of Xianyang and grand commander, became grand preceptor; Cong, prince of Xihe and inspector of Si, became grand commander.

sentences.zh: 己丑，前南青州刺史大野拔斬樊子鵠以降，兗州平。

translations.literal: Day jichou: former southern inspector of Qing Province Daye Ba beheaded Fan Zihe and surrendered; Yan Province was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Daye Ba, former southern inspector of Qing, beheaded Fan Zihe and surrendered; Yan province was pacified.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，蕭衍司州刺史陳慶之寇豫州，刺史堯雄擊走之。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Xiao Yan's inspector of Si Province Chen Qingzhi raided Yu Province; Inspector Yao Xiong struck and drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Chen Qingzhi, inspector of Si under Xiao Yan, raided Yu; Inspector Yao Xiong beat him back.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，以司徒高盛為太尉，以司空高昂為司徒，濟陰王暉業為司空。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinyou: Minister over the Masses Gao Sheng was made grand commander; Minister of Works Gao Ang was made minister over the masses; Prince of Jiyin Huiye was made minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinyou day, Gao Sheng became grand commander, Gao Ang minister over the masses, and Huiye, prince of Jiyin, minister of works.

sentences.zh: 齊獻武王討平山胡劉蠡升，斬之。

translations.literal: Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) campaigned against and pacified the Mountain Hu Liu Lixing and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) suppressed the Mountain Hu Liu Lixing and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 其子南海王復僭帝號，獻武王進擊，破擒之，及其弟西海王、皇后、夫人已下四百人，并逋逃之人二萬餘戶。

translations.literal: His son, the self-styled Prince of Nanhai, again usurped the imperial title; Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) advanced, attacked, broke him, and captured him, together with his younger brother the self-styled Prince of Xihai, the empress, ladies, and more than four hundred persons below them, and also more than twenty thousand households of fugitives.
translations.idiomatic: His son, who had styled himself Prince of Nanhai, again claimed the throne; Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) advanced, broke him, and took him prisoner, with his brother the self-styled Prince of Xihai, the empress, consorts, and more than four hundred persons besides, and over twenty thousand fugitive households.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以旱故，詔京邑及諸州郡縣收瘞骸骨。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: because of drought, an edict ordered the capital and all provinces, commanderies, and counties to gather and bury exposed bones.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, because of drought, an edict ordered the capital and every province, commandery, and county to gather and bury exposed bones.

sentences.zh: 是春，高麗、契丹並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That spring, Koguryŏ and Khitan both sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That spring Koguryŏ and the Khitan both sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，前青州刺史侯淵反，[4]攻掠青齊。

translations.literal: [4] Former inspector of Qing Province Hou Yuan rebelled and raided Qing and Qi.
translations.idiomatic: [4] Hou Yuan, former inspector of Qing, rebelled and raided Qing and Qi.

sentences.zh: 癸未，濟州刺史蔡儁討平之。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Inspector of Ji Province Cai Jun campaigned against and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Cai Jun, inspector of Ji, campaigned against him and pacified the region.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，降京師見囚。

translations.literal: Day renchen: prisoners held for audience at the capital were released.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day prisoners awaiting audience at the capital were released.

sentences.zh: 五月，大旱，勒城門、殿門及省、府、寺、署、坊門澆人，不簡王公，無限日，得雨乃止。

translations.literal: Fifth month: great drought; at city gates, palace gates, and the gates of ministries, offices, temples, agencies, and wards people were made to pour water—without exempting kings and dukes, with no limit of days, until rain came and then it stopped.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month a great drought struck; at every city gate, palace gate, and ministry, office, temple, agency, and ward gate water was poured—princes and dukes not excepted—with no day-limit until rain fell.

sentences.zh: 六月，元慶和寇南豫州，刺史堯雄大破之。

translations.literal: Sixth month: Yuan Qinghe raided southern Yu Province; Inspector Yao Xiong greatly defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Yuan Qinghe raided southern Yu; Inspector Yao Xiong routed him.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲戌，封汝南王悅孫綽為琅邪王。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day jiaxu: Chuo, grandson of Prince of Runan Yue, was enfeoffed as Prince of Langye.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day in the seventh month of autumn, Chuo, grandson of Yue, prince of Runan, was enfeoffed prince of Langye.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯，司空、濟陰王暉業坐事免。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinmao: Minister of Works, Prince of Jiyin Huiye was removed from office for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinmao day, Huiye, prince of Jiyin and minister of works, was dismissed for an offense.

sentences.zh: 甲午，發眾七萬六千人營新宮。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: seventy-six thousand men were levied to build the new palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day seventy-six thousand men were levied to build the new palace.

sentences.zh: 九月，齊獻武王以治民之官多不奉法，請選朝士清正者，州別遣一人，問疾苦。

translations.literal: Ninth month: Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu), because many officials who governed the people did not uphold the law, requested that upright court gentlemen be chosen—one sent to each province—to inquire into hardship and suffering.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu), finding that many magistrates broke the law, asked that upright court gentlemen be chosen, one per province, to inquire into the people's hardships.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以開府儀同三司、襄城王旭為司空。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: opening-office equal-to-three-division commander, Prince of Xiangcheng Xu was made minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Xu, prince of Xiangcheng and opening-office equal to the Three Excellencies, became minister of works.

sentences.zh: 冬十有一月丁未，蕭衍將柳仲禮寇荊州，刺史王元擊破之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month of winter, day dingwei: Xiao Yan's general Liu Zhongli raided Jing Province; Inspector Wang Yuan struck and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day in the eleventh month of winter, Liu Zhongli, a general of Xiao Yan, raided Jing; Inspector Wang Yuan defeated him.

sentences.zh: [5]癸丑，祀圓丘。

translations.literal: [5] Day guichou: the Round Mound was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: [5] On guichou day sacrifice was offered at the Round Mound.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，閶闔門災，龍見并州人家井中。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: the Gate of Heaven and Earth burned; a dragon appeared in a well at a house in Bing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Gate of Heaven and Earth burned; a dragon was seen in a household well in Bing province.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔齊文襄王起家為散騎常侍、驃騎大將軍、左光祿大夫、儀同三司、太原郡開國公，食邑三千戶。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: an edict ordered Gao Cheng (Wenxiang) to begin his career as scattered cavalier attendant, general of agile cavalry, left grandee of splendid appearance, equal-to-three-division commander, and Duke of Taiyuan Commandery, state-founding, with a fief of three thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day an edict launched Gao Cheng (Wenxiang) as scattered cavalier attendant, general of agile cavalry, left grandee of splendid appearance, equal-to-three-division commander, and state-founding duke of Taiyuan commandery, with a fief of three thousand households.

sentences.zh: 十有二月壬午，車駕狩于鄴東。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renwu: the imperial carriage hunted east of Ye.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renwu day, the emperor hunted east of Ye.

sentences.zh: 甲午，文武百官，量事各給祿。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: civil and military officials of every rank were given salary according to their posts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day civil and military officials of every rank received salary according to their posts.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月癸卯朔，饗羣臣於前殿。

translations.literal: Third year, first month of spring, new moon on guimao: the hundred ministers were feasted in the front hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on the guimao new moon of the first month of spring, the ministers were feasted in the front hall.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔百官舉士，舉不稱才者兩免之。

translations.literal: Day wushen: an edict ordered the hundred officials to recommend scholars; those who recommended unworthy men were twice dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day an edict ordered officials to recommend scholars; recommenders of unworthy men were dismissed twice.

sentences.zh: 齊獻武王襲寶炬西夏州，克之。

translations.literal: Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) raided Baoju's Western Xia Province and took it.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) raided Western Xia under Baoju and took it.

sentences.zh: 詔加齊獻武王九錫之禮，侍中元子思敦諭。

translations.literal: An edict added the nine bestowals for Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu); Attendant-in-ordinary Yuan Zisi was sent to press the grant.
translations.idiomatic: An edict offered Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) the nine bestowals; Attendant-in-ordinary Yuan Zisi was sent to press him to accept.

sentences.zh: 固讓乃止。

translations.literal: He firmly declined and it was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: He firmly declined and the grant was withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 二月丁未，蕭衍光州刺史郝樹以州內附。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingwei: Xiao Yan's inspector of Guang Province Hao Shu brought his province in to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dingwei day, Hao Shu, inspector of Guang under Xiao Yan, brought his province in.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔加齊文襄王使持節、尚書令、大行臺、大都督，以鮮卑、高車酋庶皆隸之。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: an edict added for Gao Cheng (Wenxiang) commissioner with full powers, Director of the Masters of Writing, grand mobile office, and commander-in-chief; all Xianbei and Gaoche chiefs and commoners were placed under him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day an edict added for Gao Cheng (Wenxiang) commissioner with full powers, director of the Masters of Writing, grand mobile office, and commander-in-chief, with all Xianbei and Gaoche chiefs and tribesmen placed under his command.

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅，以開府儀同三司、華山王鷙為大司馬。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiayin: opening-office equal-to-three-division commander, Prince of Huashan Zhi was made grand marshal.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiayin day, Zhi, prince of Huashan and opening-office equal to the Three Excellencies, became grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，陽夏太守盧公纂據郡南叛，大都督元整破之。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Administrator of Yangxia Lu Gongzuan held the southern part of the commandery in rebellion; Commander-in-chief Yuan Zheng defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Lu Gongzuan, administrator of Yangxia, rebelled in the south of the commandery; Commander-in-chief Yuan Zheng defeated him.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁酉，昌樂王誕薨。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, day dingyou: Prince of Changle Dan died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day in the fourth month of summer, Dan, prince of Changle, died.

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯，賜鰥寡孤獨貧窮者衣物各有差。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guimao: widowers, widows, orphans, solitaries, and the poor were given clothing in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guimao day, widowers, widows, orphans, solitaries, and the destitute received clothing in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以錄尚書事、西河王悰為司州牧。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Recorder of the Masters of Writing, Prince of Xihe Cong was made regional inspector of Si Province.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Cong, prince of Xihe and recorder of the Masters of Writing, became inspector of Si province.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，太尉高盛薨。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Grand Commander Gao Sheng died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Grand Commander Gao Sheng died.

sentences.zh: 六月辛巳，趙郡王諶薨。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinsi: Prince of Zhao Commandery Chen died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinsi day, Chen, prince of Zhao commandery, died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚子，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day gengzi: a general amnesty was granted to all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day in the seventh month of autumn the realm was amnestied.

sentences.zh: 蕭衍夏州刺史田獨鞞、潁川防城都督劉鸞慶並以州內附。

translations.literal: Xiao Yan's inspector of Xia Province Tian Dubi and the defense commander of Yingchuan Liu Luanqing both brought their provinces in to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Dubi, inspector of Xia under Xiao Yan, and Liu Luanqing, defense commander of Yingchuan, both brought their provinces in.

sentences.zh: 八月，并、肆、汾、建四州隕霜，[6]大飢。

translations.literal: Eighth month: Bing, Xi, Fen, and Jian provinces had frost fall; [6] great famine.
translations.idiomatic: [6] In the eighth month Bing, Xi, Fen, and Jian provinces had frost; famine followed.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，以定州刺史侯景兼尚書右僕射、南道行臺，節度諸軍南討。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renyin: Inspector of Ding Province Hou Jing was made concurrent Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and southern-route grand mobile office, directing all armies in the southern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renyin day, Hou Jing, inspector of Ding, became concurrent vice director and southern-route grand mobile office, directing the southern armies.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，陽平人路季禮聚眾反。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Lu Jili of Yangping gathered a band and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Lu Jili of Yangping raised a band and rebelled.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，御史中尉竇泰討平之。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Censor-in-chief Dou Tai campaigned against and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Censor-in-chief Dou Tai suppressed him.

sentences.zh: 是歲，高麗國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year the state of Koguryŏ sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Koguryŏ sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月，禁十五日相偷戲。

translations.literal: Fourth year, first month of spring: on the fifteenth day stealing games were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, first month of spring, stealing games on the fifteenth were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 竇泰失利自殺。

translations.literal: Dou Tai, having met defeat, killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Tai, defeated, killed himself.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，高敖曹攻上洛，克之，擒寶炬驃騎大將軍、洛州刺史泉企。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: Gao Aocao attacked Shangluo, took it, and captured Baoju's general of agile cavalry, regional inspector of Luo Quan Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Gao Aocao took Shangluo and captured Quan Qi, Baoju's general of agile cavalry and inspector of Luo.

sentences.zh: [7]按張說是，今據周書改。

translations.literal: [7] According to Zhang's collation this reading is correct; the text is now amended in accordance with the Book of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: [7] Collation note: Zhang's reading is accepted here; the text follows the Book of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 以汝陽王暹為錄尚書事。

translations.literal: Prince of Ruyang Xian was made recorder of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Xian, prince of Ruyang, was made recorder of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛未，遷七帝神主入新廟，大赦天下，內外百官普進一階。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, day xinwei: the spirit tablets of seven emperors were moved into the new temple; a general amnesty was granted to all under Heaven; civil and military officials within and without were all advanced one rank.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day in the fourth month of summer the spirit tablets of seven emperors entered the new temple; the realm was amnestied and every official within and without the court was promoted one rank.

sentences.zh: 先是，滎陽人張儉等聚眾反於大騩山，通寶炬。

translations.literal: Earlier, Zhang Jian of Xingyang and others had gathered a band and rebelled on Mount Daqi, communicating with Baoju.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Zhang Jian of Xingyang and others had raised a band on Mount Daqi in communication with Baoju.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，武衞將軍高元盛討破之。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Martial Guard General Gao Yuansheng campaigned against and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Martial Guard General Gao Yuansheng defeated them.

sentences.zh: [8]六月己巳，幸華林園理訟。

translations.literal: [8] Sixth month, day jisi: the emperor visited Hualin Park to judge lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: [8] In the sixth month, on jisi day, the emperor heard lawsuits at Hualin Park.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔尚書掩骼埋胾，推錄囚徒。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: an edict ordered the Masters of Writing to gather exposed bones and bury flesh; prisoners were reviewed and recorded.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day an edict ordered the Masters of Writing to bury the dead and review prisoners.

sentences.zh: 壬午，閶闔門災。

translations.literal: Day renwu: the Gate of Heaven and Earth burned.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day the Gate of Heaven and Earth burned.

sentences.zh: 先是，蕭衍因益州刺史傅和請通好。

translations.literal: Earlier, Xiao Yan, through Inspector of Yi Province Fu He, had requested friendly relations.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Xiao Yan, through Fu He, inspector of Yi, had sought friendly relations.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰，遣兼散騎常侍李諧、[9]兼吏部郎中盧元明、兼通直散騎常侍李鄴使于蕭衍。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day jiachen: Concurrent Scattered Cavalier Attendant Li Xie, [9] Concurrent Director of Personnel Lu Yuanming, and Concurrent Direct-palace Scattered Cavalier Attendant Li Ye were sent as envoys to Xiao Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day in the seventh month of autumn Li Xie, concurrent scattered cavalier attendant, [9] Lu Yuanming, concurrent director of personnel, and Li Ye, concurrent direct-palace scattered cavalier attendant, were sent to Xiao Yan.

sentences.zh: 八月，寶炬、宇文黑獺寇陝州，城陷，刺史李徽伯為黑獺所殺。

translations.literal: Eighth month: Baoju and Yuwen Heitu raided Shaan Province; the city fell and Inspector Li Huibo was killed by Heitu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Baoju and Yuwen Heitu raided Shaan; the city fell and Inspector Li Huibo was slain by Heitu.

sentences.zh: 九月，侍中元子思與其弟子華謀西入，並賜死。

translations.literal: Ninth month: Attendant-in-ordinary Yuan Zisi plotted with his nephew Zihua to enter the west; both were granted death.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Yuan Zisi plotted with his nephew Zihua to flee west; both were put to death.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙丑，衞將軍、右光祿大夫蔣天樂謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day yichou: Defender General, Right Grandee of Splendid Appearance Jiang Tianle plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day in the intercalary month Jiang Tianle, defender general and right grandee of splendid appearance, plotted rebellion and was executed.

sentences.zh: 禁京師酤酒。

translations.literal: Selling wine in the capital was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: The sale of wine in the capital was forbidden.

translations.literal: The text is deficient.
translations.idiomatic: The text is deficient.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，以咸陽王坦為錄尚書事。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter: Prince of Xianyang Tan was made recorder of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter Tan, prince of Xianyang, was made recorder of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，齊獻武王西討，至沙苑，不克而還。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) campaigned west, reached Shazhou, could not take it, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) marched west to Shazhou, failed to win, and turned back.

sentences.zh: 己酉，寶炬行臺宮景壽、都督楊白駒寇洛州，大都督韓延大破之。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Baoju's grand mobile office Gong Jingshou and Commander Yang Baiju raided Luo Province; Commander-in-chief Han Yan greatly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Gong Jingshou, Baoju's grand mobile office, and Commander Yang Baiju raided Luo; Commander-in-chief Han Yan routed them.

sentences.zh: [11]寶炬又遣其子大行臺元季海、大都督獨孤如願逼洛州，刺史廣陽王湛棄城退還，季海、如願遂據金墉。

translations.literal: [11] Baoju again sent his son, grand mobile office Yuan Jihai, and Commander-in-chief Dugu Ruyuan to press Luo Province; Inspector, Prince of Guangyang Zhan abandoned the city and withdrew; Jihai and Ruyuan then held Jinyong.
translations.idiomatic: [11] Baoju again sent his son Yuan Jihai, grand mobile office, and Commander-in-chief Dugu Ruyuan against Luo; Zhan, prince of Guangyang and inspector, abandoned the city; Jihai and Ruyuan then held Jinyong.

sentences.zh: 潁州長史賀若微執刺史田迅西叛，[12]引寶炬都督梁回據城。

translations.literal: Chief clerk of Ying Province He Ruo Wei seized Inspector Tian Xun and rebelled westward; [12] he brought in Baoju's commander Liang Hui to hold the city.
translations.idiomatic: He Ruo Wei, chief clerk of Ying, seized Inspector Tian Xun and rebelled west, [12] bringing in Baoju's commander Liang Hui to hold the city.

sentences.zh: 寶炬又遣其都督趙繼宗、右丞韋孝寬等攻陷豫州。

translations.literal: Baoju again sent his commanders Zhao Jizong, Right Assistant Director Wei Xiaokuan, and others to attack and take Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: Baoju again sent Zhao Jizong, Wei Xiaokuan, and others to take Yu.

sentences.zh: 十有一月丙子，以驃騎大將軍、儀同三司万俟普為太尉。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingzi: General of Agile Cavalry, Equal-to-three-division Commander Wanqi Pu was made grand commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingzi day, Wanqi Pu, general of agile cavalry and equal to the Three Excellencies, became grand commander.

sentences.zh: 十有二月甲寅，蕭衍遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiayin: Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiayin day, Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 河間人邢摩納、范陽人盧仲禮等各聚眾反。

translations.literal: Xing Mo of Hejian and Lu Zhongli of Fanyang each gathered bands and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Xing Mo of Hejian and Lu Zhongli of Fanyang each raised bands in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 是歲，高麗、蠕蠕國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Koguryŏ and Rouran both sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Koguryŏ and Rouran both sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚寅，曲赦畿內。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, day gengyin: a partial amnesty within the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day in the fourth month of summer the capital region received a partial amnesty.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，齊獻武王還晉陽，請開酒禁。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) returned to Jinyang and requested that the ban on wine be lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) returned to Jinyang and asked that the wine ban be lifted.

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰，帝幸華林都堂聽訟。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renchen: the emperor visited Hualin Metropolitan Hall to hear lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renchen day, the emperor heard lawsuits at Hualin Metropolitan Hall.

sentences.zh: 是夏，山東大水，蝦蟆鳴于樹上。

translations.literal: That summer eastern Shandong had great floods; frogs croaked in trees.
translations.idiomatic: That summer eastern Shandong flooded; frogs croaked in the trees.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙亥，[13]高麗國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: [13] Seventh month of autumn, day yihai: the state of Koguryŏ sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: [13] On yihai day in the seventh month of autumn Koguryŏ sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 行臺侯景、司徒公高敖曹圍寶炬將獨孤如願於金墉，寶炬、宇文黑獺並來赴救。

translations.literal: Grand mobile office Hou Jing and Minister over the Masses Gao Aocao besieged Baoju's general Dugu Ruyuan at Jinyong; Baoju and Yuwen Heitu both came to rescue.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing, grand mobile office, and Gao Aocao, minister over the masses, besieged Dugu Ruyuan, Baoju's general, at Jinyong; Baoju and Yuwen Heitu came to relieve him.

sentences.zh: 大都督厙狄干率諸將前驅，齊獻武王總眾繼進。

translations.literal: Commander-in-chief Kudie Gan led the generals as vanguard; Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) followed with the main host.
translations.idiomatic: Commander-in-chief Kudie Gan led the vanguard; Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) followed with the main army.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯，戰于河陰，大破之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinmao: battle at Heyin; they were greatly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinmao day, battle was joined at Heyin and the enemy was routed.

sentences.zh: 斬其大都督、儀同三司寇洛生等二十餘人，俘獲數萬。

translations.literal: Their commander-in-chief, equal-to-three-division commander Kou Luosheng and more than twenty others were beheaded; captives numbered in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: More than twenty commanders including Kou Luosheng, equal to the Three Excellencies, were beheaded; captives numbered in the tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 司徒公高敖曹、大都督李猛、宋顯並戰沒。

translations.literal: Minister over the Masses Gao Aocao, Commander-in-chief Li Meng, and Song Xian all died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Aocao, minister over the masses, Commander-in-chief Li Meng, and Song Xian all fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 寶炬留其將長孫子彥守金墉。

translations.literal: Baoju left his general Changsun Ziyan to hold Jinyong.
translations.idiomatic: Baoju left Changsun Ziyan to hold Jinyong.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，齊獻武王濟河，子彥棄城走。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) crossed the river; Ziyan abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) crossed the river; Ziyan abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 九月，大都督賀拔仁擊邢摩納、盧仲禮等，破平之。

translations.literal: Ninth month: Commander-in-chief Heba Ren attacked Xing Mo, Lu Zhongli, and others, defeated and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Commander-in-chief Heba Ren attacked Xing Mo, Lu Zhongli, and the rest, defeated them, and pacified the region.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，蕭衍遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter: Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十有一月庚寅，遣陸操使于蕭衍。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengyin: Lu Cao was sent as envoy to Xiao Yan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengyin day, Lu Cao was sent to Xiao Yan.

sentences.zh: [14]齊獻武王來朝。

translations.literal: [14] Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) came to court.
translations.idiomatic: [14] Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) came to court.

sentences.zh: 十有二月甲辰，還晉陽。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiachen: he returned to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiachen day, he returned to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁丑，詔以齊獻武王為相國、錄尚書事、大行臺，固辭相國。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day dingchou: an edict made Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) grand chancellor, recorder of the Masters of Writing, and grand mobile office; he firmly declined the grand chancellorship.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day in the seventh month of autumn an edict made Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) grand chancellor, recorder of the Masters of Writing, and grand mobile office; he firmly declined the grand chancellorship.

sentences.zh: 八月壬辰，兼散騎常侍王元景、兼通直散騎常侍魏收使于蕭衍。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renchen: Concurrent Scattered Cavalier Attendant Wang Yuanjing and Concurrent Direct-palace Scattered Cavalier Attendant Wei Shou were sent as envoys to Xiao Yan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renchen day, Wang Yuanjing, concurrent scattered cavalier attendant, and Wei Shou, concurrent direct-palace scattered cavalier attendant, were sent to Xiao Yan.

sentences.zh: 九月甲子，發畿內民夫十萬人城鄴城，四十日罷。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiazi: one hundred thousand corvée laborers within the capital region were levied to wall Ye city; the work ended after forty days.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day in the ninth month one hundred thousand laborers of the capital region were levied to wall Ye; the work ended in forty days.

sentences.zh: 辛未，曲赦畿內死罪以下各有差。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: a partial amnesty within the capital region for death crimes and below, each in differing measure.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the capital region received a graded partial amnesty through death crimes and below.

sentences.zh: 冬十有一月癸亥，以新宮成，大赦天下，改元。

translations.literal: Eleventh month of winter, day guihai: because the new palace was completed, a general amnesty was granted to all under Heaven and the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day in the eleventh month of winter, with the new palace complete, the realm was amnestied and the era name changed.

sentences.zh: 八十以上賜綾帽及杖，七十以上賜帛，及有疾廢者賜粟帛。

translations.literal: Those eighty and above were given gauze caps and staffs; those seventy and above were given silk; those ill and disabled were given grain and silk.
translations.idiomatic: Those eighty and above received gauze caps and staffs; those seventy and above received silk; the sick and disabled received grain and silk.

sentences.zh: 築城之夫，給復一年。

translations.literal: Corvée laborers who built the walls were granted tax remission for one year.
translations.idiomatic: Laborers who built the walls were granted one year's tax remission.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月壬申，以太保尉景為太傅，以驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司厙狄干為太保。

translations.literal: Second year, first month of spring, day renshen: Grand Mentor Wei Jing was made grand preceptor; General of Agile Cavalry, Opening-office Equal-to-three-division Commander Kudie Gan was made grand mentor.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on renshen day in the first month of spring, Wei Jing became grand preceptor and Kudie Gan, general of agile cavalry and opening-office equal to the Three Excellencies, became grand mentor.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，徙御新宮，大赦，內外百官普進一階，營構主將別優一階。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: the court moved to the new palace; a general amnesty; civil and military officials within and without were all advanced one rank; chief builders were favored one rank beyond the rest.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the court moved into the new palace, amnestied the realm, promoted every official one rank, and gave the chief builders an extra rank.

sentences.zh: 三月己卯，蕭衍遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Third month, day jimao: Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jimao day, Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏五月己酉，西魏行臺宮延和、陝州刺史宮元慶率戶內屬，置之河北。

translations.literal: Fifth month of summer, day jiyou: Western Wei grand mobile office Gong Yanhe and Inspector of Shaan Province Gong Yuanqing led their households in to submit; they were settled north of the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day in the fifth month of summer, Gong Yanhe, Western Wei grand mobile office, and Gong Yuanqing, inspector of Shaan, led their households in and were settled north of the river.

sentences.zh: 新附賑廩各有差。

translations.literal: The newly submitted were relieved from the granaries in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: The newly submitted were fed from the granaries in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 壬子，遣兼散騎常侍李象使于蕭衍。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Concurrent Scattered Cavalier Attendant Li Xiang was sent as envoy to Xiao Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Li Xiang, concurrent scattered cavalier attendant, was sent to Xiao Yan.

sentences.zh: 閏月己丑，封皇兄景植為宜陽王，[15]皇弟威為清河王，謙為潁川王。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day jichou: the emperor's elder brother Jingzhi was enfeoffed Prince of Yiyang; [15] younger brothers Wei Prince of Qinghe, Qian Prince of Yingchuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day in the intercalary month the emperor's elder brother Jingzhi was made prince of Yiyang; [15] younger brothers Wei, prince of Qinghe, and Qian, prince of Yingchuan.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，大司馬華山王鷙薨。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renzi: Grand Marshal, Prince of Huashan Zhi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renzi day, Zhi, prince of Huashan and grand marshal, died.

translations.literal: The text is deficient.
translations.idiomatic: The text is deficient.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁未，蕭衍遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day dingwei: Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day in the tenth month of winter Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十有二月乙卯，遣兼散騎常侍崔長謙使於蕭衍。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yimao: Concurrent Scattered Cavalier Attendant Cui Changqian was sent as envoy to Xiao Yan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yimao day, Cui Changqian, concurrent scattered cavalier attendant, was sent to Xiao Yan.

sentences.zh: 是歲，蠕蠕、高麗、勿吉國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Rouran, Koguryŏ, and the state of Wuji all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Rouran, Koguryŏ, and Wuji all sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 三年春二月甲辰，阿至羅出吐拔那渾大率部來降。

translations.literal: Third year, second month of spring, day jiachen: Azheluo led the great chief Tuba Nahun's tribes in surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on jiachen day in the second month of spring, Azheluo led the great chief Tuba Nahun's tribes in surrender.

sentences.zh: 三月己酉，梁州人公孫貴賓聚眾反，自號天王。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiyou: Gongsun Guibin of Liang Province gathered a band and rebelled, styling himself Heavenly King.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day in the third month Gongsun Guibin of Liang province raised a band and styled himself Heavenly King.

sentences.zh: 陽夏鎮將討擒之。

translations.literal: The garrison commander of Yangxia campaigned against and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: The Yangxia garrison commander captured him.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊申，阿至羅國主副伏羅越居子去賓來降，封為高車王。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, day wushen: Fufoluoyue Juzi Qubing of the Azheluo state came in surrender and was enfeoffed King of the Gaoche.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day in the fourth month of summer Fufoluoyue Juzi Qubing of Azheluo surrendered and was made king of the Gaoche.

sentences.zh: 六月乙丑，蕭衍遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yichou: Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yichou day, Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸卯，齊文襄王自晉陽來朝。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day guimao: Gao Cheng (Wenxiang) came to court from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on guimao day, Gao Cheng (Wenxiang) came to court from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 先是，詔文襄王與羣臣於麟趾閣議定新制，甲寅，班於天下。

translations.literal: Earlier, an edict had ordered Gao Cheng (Wenxiang) and the hundred ministers to debate and fix the new statutes at Linzhi Pavilion; on jiayin they were promulgated to all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier an edict had ordered Gao Cheng (Wenxiang) and the ministers to fix the new statutes at Linzhi Pavilion; on jiayin they were promulgated throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 己巳，發夫五萬人築漳濱堰，三十五日罷。

translations.literal: Day jisi: fifty thousand corvée laborers were levied to build the Zhang River embankment; the work ended after thirty-five days.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day fifty thousand laborers were levied to build the Zhang River embankment; the work ended in thirty-five days.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，車駕狩于西山。

translations.literal: Day guihai: the imperial carriage hunted on Western Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the emperor hunted on Western Mountain.

sentences.zh: 十有一月戊寅，還宮。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuyin: the court returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuyin day, the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以開府儀同三司、彭城王韶為太尉，以度支尚書胡僧敬為司空。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: opening-office equal-to-three-division commander, Prince of Pengcheng Shao was made grand commander; Director of Revenue Hu Sengjing was made minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Shao, prince of Pengcheng and opening-office equal to the Three Excellencies, became grand commander; Hu Sengjing, director of revenue, became minister of works.

sentences.zh: 是歲，蠕蠕、高麗、勿吉國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Rouran, Koguryŏ, and the state of Wuji all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Rouran, Koguryŏ, and Wuji all sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月丙辰，蕭衍遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Fourth year, first month of spring, day bingchen: Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on bingchen day in the first month of spring, Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙寅，遣兼散騎常侍李繪使于蕭衍。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, day bingyin: Concurrent Scattered Cavalier Attendant Li Hui was sent as envoy to Xiao Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day in the fourth month of summer Li Hui, concurrent scattered cavalier attendant, was sent to Xiao Yan.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以侍中、廣陽王湛為太尉，以尚書右僕射高隆之為司徒，以太尉、彭城王韶為錄尚書事。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Attendant-in-ordinary, Prince of Guangyang Zhan was made grand commander; Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Gao Longzhi was made minister over the masses; Grand Commander, Prince of Pengcheng Shao was made recorder of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Zhan, prince of Guangyang and attendant-in-ordinary, became grand commander; Gao Longzhi, vice director of the Masters of Writing, became minister over the masses; Shao, prince of Pengcheng and grand commander, became recorder of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，太傅尉景坐事降為驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Grand Preceptor Wei Jing, for an offense, was reduced to general of agile cavalry and opening-office equal-to-three-division commander.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Wei Jing, grand preceptor, was reduced for an offense to general of agile cavalry with an opening office equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以太保厙狄干為太傅，以領軍將軍婁昭為大司馬，封祖裔為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Grand Mentor Kudie Gan was made grand preceptor; Commander of the Guards Lou Zhao was made grand marshal; Zuyi was enfeoffed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Kudie Gan became grand preceptor, Lou Zhao, commander of the guards, grand marshal, and Zuyi was made vice director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 五月辛巳，齊獻武王來朝，請令百官月一面敷政事，明揚仄陋，納諫屏邪，親理獄訟，褒黜勤怠；

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinsi: Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) came to court and requested that the hundred officials meet the emperor monthly to set forth government affairs, make known what is hidden and narrow, receive remonstrance and repel evil, personally judge lawsuits, and reward diligence and punish slackness;
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day in the fifth month Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) came to court and asked that officials meet the throne monthly to conduct government, bring hidden wrongs to light, accept remonstrance and drive off evil, judge cases in person, and reward the diligent while punishing the slack;

sentences.zh: 牧守有愆，節級相坐；

translations.literal: if regional inspectors and prefects were at fault, ranks were to be reduced by stages with mutual liability;
translations.idiomatic: regional inspectors and prefects who erred were to be punished by stages with mutual liability;

sentences.zh: 椒掖之內，進御以序；

translations.literal: within the inner quarters, consorts were to attend the ruler in order;
translations.idiomatic: within the inner quarters consorts were to attend the ruler in proper order;

sentences.zh: 後園鷹犬，悉皆放棄。

translations.literal: hawks and dogs of the rear garden were all to be released.
translations.idiomatic: and hawks and dogs of the rear garden were all to be released.

sentences.zh: 六月，還晉陽。

translations.literal: Sixth month: he returned to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he returned to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 丙申，復前侍中、樂浪王忠爵。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: former Attendant-in-ordinary, Prince of Lelang Zhong's title was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day the title of Zhong, former attendant-in-ordinary and prince of Lelang, was restored.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，復陳留王景皓、常山王紹宗、高密王永業爵。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: the titles of Prince of Chenliu Jinghao, Prince of Changshan Shaozong, and Prince of Gaomi Yongye were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day the titles of Jinghao, prince of Chenliu, Shaozong, prince of Changshan, and Yongye, prince of Gaomi, were restored.

sentences.zh: 秋八月庚戌，以開府儀同三司、吏部尚書侯景為兼尚書僕射、河南行臺，隨機討防。

translations.literal: Eighth month of autumn, day gengxu: opening-office equal-to-three-division commander, Director of Personnel Hou Jing was made concurrent Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Henan-route grand mobile office, campaigning and defending as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day in the eighth month of autumn Hou Jing, opening-office equal to the Three Excellencies and director of personnel, became concurrent vice director and Henan-route grand mobile office, to campaign and defend as needed.

sentences.zh: 是歲，蠕蠕、高麗、吐谷渾國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Rouran, Koguryŏ, and the Tuyuhun state all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Rouran, Koguryŏ, and Tuyuhun all sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，封彭城王韶弟襲為武安王。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer: Xi, younger brother of Prince of Pengcheng Shao, was enfeoffed Prince of Wu'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer Xi, younger brother of Shao, prince of Pengcheng, was made prince of Wu'an.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰，以克復虎牢，降天下死罪以下囚。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renchen: because Hulao had been recovered, prisoners under death sentence and below throughout the realm were released.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day in the fifth month, with Hulao recovered, prisoners through death crimes and below were released throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以吏部尚書侯景為司空。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Director of Personnel Hou Jing was made minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Hou Jing, director of personnel, became minister of works.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，蕭衍遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yihai: Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yihai day, Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，封前員外散騎侍郎元長春為南郡王。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: former supernumerary scattered cavalier attendant Yuan Changchun was enfeoffed Prince of Nan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Yuan Changchun, former supernumerary scattered cavalier attendant, was made prince of Nan commandery.

sentences.zh: 秋八月乙未，以汾州刺史斛律金為大司馬。

translations.literal: Eighth month of autumn, day yiwei: Inspector of Fen Province Hulu Jin was made grand marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day in the eighth month of autumn Hulu Jin, inspector of Fen, became grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 壬午，遣兼散騎常侍李渾使于蕭衍。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Concurrent Scattered Cavalier Attendant Li Hun was sent as envoy to Xiao Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Li Hun, concurrent scattered cavalier attendant, was sent to Xiao Yan.

sentences.zh: 是月，齊獻武王召夫五萬於肆州北山築城，西自馬陵戍，東至土隥。

translations.literal: That month Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) summoned fifty thousand corvée laborers at Northern Mountain in Xi Province to build a wall, west from Maling garrison east to Tuxian.
translations.idiomatic: That month Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) summoned fifty thousand laborers at Northern Mountain in Xi to build a wall from Maling garrison west to Tuxian east.

sentences.zh: 四十日罷。

translations.literal: The work ended after forty days.
translations.idiomatic: The work ended in forty days.

sentences.zh: 冬十有一月甲午，車駕狩于西山。

translations.literal: Eleventh month of winter, day jiawu: the imperial carriage hunted on Western Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day in the eleventh month of winter the emperor hunted on Western Mountain.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，還宮。

translations.literal: Day yisi: the court returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 是歲，吐谷渾、高麗、蠕蠕國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Tuyuhun, Koguryŏ, and Rouran all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Tuyuhun, Koguryŏ, and Rouran all sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月，地豆于國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Second year, first month of spring: the state of Didouyu sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, first month of spring, Didouyu sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月丁卯，徐州人劉烏黑聚眾反。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingmao: Liu Wuhei of Xu Province gathered a band and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dingmao day, Liu Wuhei of Xu province raised a band in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 遣行臺慕容紹宗討平之。

translations.literal: Grand mobile office Murong Shaozong was sent to campaign against and pacify him.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Shaozong, grand mobile office, was sent to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 三月，蕭衍遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Third month: Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 以旱故，宥死罪以下囚。

translations.literal: Because of drought, prisoners under death sentence and below were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Because of drought, prisoners through death crimes and below were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以開府儀同三司孫騰為太保。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: opening-office equal-to-three-division commander Sun Teng was made grand mentor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Sun Teng, opening-office equal to the Three Excellencies, became grand mentor.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以齊文襄王為大將軍，領侍中，其文武職事、賞罰眾典，詢稟之。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Gao Cheng (Wenxiang) was made grand general and concurrent attendant-in-ordinary; on civil and military duties, rewards and punishments, and the great statutes, he was to be consulted.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Gao Cheng (Wenxiang) was made grand general and concurrent attendant-in-ordinary; civil and military appointments, rewards, punishments, and major regulations were referred to him.

sentences.zh: 中書監元弼為錄尚書，左僕射司馬子如為尚書令，以今上為右僕射。

translations.literal: Director of the Secretariat Yuan Bi was made recorder of the Masters of Writing; Left Vice Director Sima Ziru was made Director of the Masters of Writing; the Present Sovereign was made right vice director.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Bi, director of the secretariat, became recorder of the Masters of Writing; Sima Ziru, left vice director, became director; the Present Sovereign became right vice director.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，室韋國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer: the Shiwei state sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer the Shiwei sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午，遣散騎常侍魏季景使于蕭衍。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiawu: Scattered Cavalier Attendant Wei Jijing was sent as envoy to Xiao Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day in the fifth month Wei Jijing, scattered cavalier attendant, was sent to Xiao Yan.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，太尉、廣陽王湛薨。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Grand Commander, Prince of Guangyang Zhan died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Zhan, prince of Guangyang and grand commander, died.

sentences.zh: 秋八月癸酉，尚書令司馬子如坐事免。

translations.literal: Eighth month of autumn, day guiyou: Director of the Masters of Writing Sima Ziru, for an offense, was removed from office.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day in the eighth month of autumn Sima Ziru, director of the Masters of Writing, was dismissed for an offense.

sentences.zh: 九月甲申，以開府儀同三司、濟陰王暉業為太尉。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiashen: opening-office equal-to-three-division commander, Prince of Jiyin Huiye was made grand commander.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day in the ninth month Huiye, prince of Jiyin and opening-office equal to the Three Excellencies, became grand commander.

sentences.zh: 太師、咸陽王坦坐事免，以王還第。

translations.literal: Grand Preceptor, Prince of Xianyang Tan, for an offense was removed from office and returned to his residence.
translations.idiomatic: Tan, prince of Xianyang and grand preceptor, was dismissed for an offense and sent home.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁巳，太保孫騰、大司馬高隆之各為括戶大使，[18]凡獲逃戶六十餘萬。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day dingsi: Grand Mentor Sun Teng and Grand Marshal Gao Longzhi were each made commissioners for registering households; [18] in all more than six hundred thousand fugitive households were recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day in the tenth month of winter Sun Teng, grand mentor, and Gao Longzhi, grand marshal, were each made commissioners for registering households; [18] in all more than six hundred thousand fugitive households were recovered.

sentences.zh: 十有一月，西河地陷，有火出。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: the ground collapsed in Xihe and fire burst forth.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the ground collapsed in Xihe and fire burst forth.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以司徒高隆之為尚書令，以前大司馬婁昭為司徒。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Minister over the Masses Gao Longzhi was made Director of the Masters of Writing; former Grand Marshal Lou Zhao was made minister over the masses.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Gao Longzhi, minister over the masses, became director of the Masters of Writing and Lou Zhao, former grand marshal, minister over the masses.

sentences.zh: 齊文襄王如晉陽。

translations.literal: Gao Cheng (Wenxiang) went to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Cheng (Wenxiang) went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 庚子，車駕有事於圓丘。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: the imperial carriage performed rites at the Round Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day the emperor performed rites at the Round Mound.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，蕭衍遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，齊文襄王從獻武王討山胡，破之，俘獲一萬餘戶，分配諸州。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Gao Cheng (Wenxiang) followed Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) in campaigning against the Mountain Hu, defeated them, and captured more than ten thousand households, who were distributed among the provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Gao Cheng (Wenxiang) followed Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) against the Mountain Hu, defeated them, and distributed more than ten thousand captive households among the provinces.

sentences.zh: 是歲，吐谷渾、高麗、蠕蠕、勿吉國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Tuyuhun, Koguryŏ, Rouran, and the state of Wuji all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Tuyuhun, Koguryŏ, Rouran, and Wuji all sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丙申，遣兼散騎常侍李奬使于蕭衍。

translations.literal: Third year, first month of spring, day bingshen: Concurrent Scattered Cavalier Attendant Li Jiang was sent as envoy to Xiao Yan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on bingshen day in the first month of spring, Li Jiang, concurrent scattered cavalier attendant, was sent to Xiao Yan.

sentences.zh: 丁未，齊獻武王請於并州置晉陽宮，以處配沒之口。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) requested that a Jinyang palace be established at Bing Province to house confiscated dependents.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) asked that a Jinyang palace be built at Bing to house confiscated dependents.

sentences.zh: 二月庚申，吐谷渾國奉其從妹以備後庭，納為容華嬪。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengshen: the Tuyuhun state presented a younger sister of the ruler to fill the rear quarters; she was received as Ronghua concubine.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day in the second month Tuyuhun presented a younger sister of the ruler for the inner palace; she was received as Ronghua concubine.

sentences.zh: 夏五月甲辰，大赦天下。

translations.literal: Fifth month of summer, day jiachen: a general amnesty was granted to all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day in the fifth month of summer the realm was amnestied.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚子，蕭衍遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, day gengzi: Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day in the seventh month of autumn Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，遣中書舍人尉瑾使于蕭衍。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter: Secretariat Attendant Wei Jin was sent as envoy to Xiao Yan.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter Wei Jin, secretariat attendant, was sent to Xiao Yan.

sentences.zh: 乙未，齊獻武王請邙山之俘，釋其桎梏，配以人間寡婦。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) requested captives from Mount Mang be released from fetters and paired with widows among the people.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Gao Huan (Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu) asked that captives from Mount Mang be freed from bonds and matched with widows among the people.

sentences.zh: 十有二月，以司空侯景為司徒，以中書令韓軌為司空。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Minister of Works Hou Jing was made Minister of Education, and Secretariat Director Han Gui was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Hou Jing, minister of works, was made minister of education, and Han Gui, director of the secretariat, was made minister of works.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以太保孫騰為錄尚書事。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, Grand Preceptor Sun Teng was made recorder of Masters of Writing affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Sun Teng, grand preceptor, was made recorder of Masters of Writing affairs.

sentences.zh: 是歲，高麗、吐谷渾、蠕蠕國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Koguryo, Tuyuhun, and Rouran all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Koguryo, Tuyuhun, and Rouran all sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 四年夏五月壬寅，蕭衍遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, fifth month of summer, on renyin day, Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on renyin day in the fifth month of summer, Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子，以司徒侯景為河南大行臺，應機討防。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on gengzi day, Minister of Education Hou Jing was made grand mobile office of Henan to strike and defend as occasion demanded.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengzi day, Hou Jing, minister of education, was made grand mobile office of Henan to strike and defend as occasion demanded.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬寅，遣兼散騎常侍元廓使于蕭衍。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, on renyin day, Supernumerary Scattered Cavalier Attendant Yuan Kuo was sent as envoy to Xiao Yan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renyin day, Yuan Kuo, supernumerary scattered cavalier attendant, was sent as envoy to Xiao Yan.

sentences.zh: 八月，移洛陽漢魏石經于鄴。

translations.literal: Eighth month: the Han and Wei stone classics at Luoyang were moved to Ye.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Han and Wei stone classics were moved from Luoyang to Ye.

sentences.zh: 齊獻武王自鄴帥眾西伐，文襄王會于晉州。

translations.literal: Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu led his host west from Ye in campaign; Prince of Qi Wenxiang joined him at Jin province.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Qi Duke Xianwu marched west from Ye; Prince of Qi Wenxiang joined him at Jin province.

sentences.zh: 九月，圍玉壁以挑之，寶炬、黑獺不敢應。

translations.literal: Ninth month: they besieged Yubi to provoke battle; Baoju and Hei La did not dare respond.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month they besieged Yubi to provoke battle; Baoju and Hei La did not dare respond.

sentences.zh: 冬十有一月，齊獻武王有疾，班師。

translations.literal: Eleventh month of winter: Duke Xianwu of Qi fell ill and the army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter Duke Xianwu of Qi fell ill and the army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 文襄王如晉陽。

translations.literal: Prince Wenxiang went to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Wenxiang went to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 是歲，室韋、勿吉、地豆于、高麗、蠕蠕國，並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Shiwei, Wuji, Dudouyu, Koguryo, and Rouran all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Shiwei, Wuji, Dudouyu, Koguryo, and Rouran all sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌，詔贈王假黃鉞、使持節、相國、都督中外諸軍事、齊王璽紱，轀輬車、黃屋、左纛、前後羽葆、鼓吹、輕車介士，兼備九錫之禮，諡曰獻武王。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, on wuxu day, an edict posthumously granted the king the yellow battle-axe, commissioner with full powers, chancellor, commander of all military affairs within and without, the Qi prince's seal and sash, the imperial carriage with curved canopy, yellow roof, left banner, front and rear feathered parasols, drum and pipe music, light chariots and armored escorts, and the full rites of the Nine Bestowals; his posthumous title was Duke Xianwu.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on wuxu day, an edict posthumously granted the king the yellow battle-axe, commissioner with full powers, chancellor, commander of all military affairs within and without, the Qi prince's seal and sash, the imperial carriage with curved canopy, yellow roof, left banner, front and rear feathered parasols, drum and pipe music, light chariots and armored escorts, and the full rites of the nine bestowals; his posthumous title was Duke Xianwu.

sentences.zh: 以齊文襄王為使持節、大丞相、都督中外諸軍事、錄尚書事、大行臺、勃海王。

translations.literal: Prince of Qi Wenxiang was made commissioner with full powers, grand chancellor, commander of all military affairs within and without, recorder of Masters of Writing affairs, grand mobile office, and Prince of Bohai.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Qi Wenxiang was made commissioner with full powers, grand chancellor, commander of all military affairs within and without, recorder of Masters of Writing affairs, grand mobile office, and prince of Bohai.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔王攝理軍國，遣中使敦諭。

translations.literal: On renyin day an edict ordered the prince to oversee state and military affairs; a palace envoy was sent to urge him earnestly.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day an edict ordered the prince to oversee state and military affairs, and a palace envoy was sent to urge him earnestly.

sentences.zh: 八月，[22]齊文襄王入朝，固辭丞相，詔復授大將軍，餘如故。

translations.literal: [22] Eighth month: Prince of Qi Wenxiang entered court and firmly declined the chancellorship; an edict again appointed him grand general, the rest remaining as before.
translations.idiomatic: [22] In the eighth month Prince of Qi Wenxiang entered court and firmly declined the chancellorship; an edict again appointed him grand general, with all else unchanged.

sentences.zh: 甲申，葬齊獻武王於鄴城西北，車駕祖於漳濱。

translations.literal: On jiashen day Duke Xianwu of Qi was buried northwest of Ye city; the imperial carriage farewelled him on the Zhang bank.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Duke Xianwu of Qi was buried northwest of Ye; the imperial carriage farewelled him on the Zhang bank.

sentences.zh: 九月，齊文襄王還晉陽。

translations.literal: Ninth month: Prince Wenxiang returned to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Prince Wenxiang returned to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，蕭衍遣其兄子貞陽侯淵明帥眾寇徐州，堰泗水於寒山，灌彭城，以應侯景。

translations.literal: On xinyou day Xiao Yan sent his elder brother's son Marquis Yuanming of Zhenyang to lead troops against Xuzhou, dam the Si River at Cold Mountain, and flood Pengcheng to coordinate with Hou Jing.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Xiao Yan sent his nephew Marquis Yuanming of Zhenyang to raid Xuzhou, dam the Si at Cold Mountain, flood Pengcheng, and coordinate with Hou Jing.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙酉，以尚書左僕射慕容紹宗為東南道行臺，與驃騎大將軍、儀同三司、大都督高岳，潘相樂討淵明。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, on yiyou day, Murong Shaozong, left vice director of the Masters of Writing, was made grand mobile office of the southeast route; together with Grand General of Agile Cavalry, equal in honor to the Three Excellencies, and grand commander Gao Yue and Pan Xiangle he campaigned against Yuanming.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on yiyou day, Murong Shaozong, left vice director of the Masters of Writing, was made grand mobile office of the southeast route; with Gao Yue, grand general of agile cavalry, equal in honor to the three excellencies and grand commander, and Pan Xiangle he attacked Yuanming.

sentences.zh: 十有一月，大破之，擒淵明及其二子瑀、道，將帥二百餘人，俘斬五萬級，凍乏赴水死者不可勝數。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: they inflicted a great defeat, captured Yuanming and his two sons Yu and Dao, more than two hundred commanders, took and slew fifty thousand, and those who died of cold, exhaustion, or drowning were beyond count.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month they routed the enemy, captured Yuanming and his sons Yu and Dao, more than two hundred commanders, and killed or captured fifty thousand; countless others died of cold, exhaustion, or drowning.

sentences.zh: 十有二月乙亥，蕭淵明至闕，帝御閶闔門讓而宥之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on yihai day, Xiao Yuanming reached the capital; the emperor received him at Changhe Gate, rebuked him, and pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yihai day, Xiao Yuanming reached the capital; the emperor met him at Changhe Gate, rebuked him, and pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 岳等回師討侯景。

translations.literal: Yue and the others turned their army to campaign against Hou Jing.
translations.idiomatic: Yue and the others turned their army against Hou Jing.

sentences.zh: 是歲，高麗、勿吉國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Koguryo and Wuji both sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Koguryo and Wuji both sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月己亥，大都督高岳等於渦陽大破侯景，俘斬五萬餘人，其餘溺死於渦水，水為之不流。

translations.literal: Spring, first month of the sixth year, on jihai day, Grand Commander Gao Yue and others at Woyang greatly defeated Hou Jing, capturing and slaying more than fifty thousand; the rest drowned in the Wo River until the water would not flow.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the sixth year, on jihai day, Gao Yue and others at Woyang crushed Hou Jing, killing or capturing more than fifty thousand; the rest drowned in the Wo River until it would not flow.

sentences.zh: 景走淮南。

translations.literal: Jing fled to Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: Jing fled to Huainan.

sentences.zh: 己未，齊文襄王來朝，請以寒山獲士賜百官及督將等，各有差。

translations.literal: On jiwei day Prince of Qi Wenxiang came to court and asked that captives taken at Cold Mountain be granted to the hundred offices and supervising generals in graded shares.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Prince of Qi Wenxiang came to court and asked that captives from Cold Mountain be granted to officials and generals in graded shares.

sentences.zh: 二月己卯，蕭衍遣使款闕乞和，并修書弔齊文襄王。

translations.literal: Second month, on jimao day, Xiao Yan sent envoys suing at the gate for peace and also sent a letter of condolence to Prince of Qi Wenxiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jimao day, Xiao Yan sent envoys suing for peace at the gate and a letter of condolence to Prince of Qi Wenxiang.

sentences.zh: 文襄王還晉陽。

translations.literal: Prince Wenxiang returned to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Wenxiang returned to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳，以太尉、襄城王旭為大司馬，以開府儀同三司高岳為太尉。

translations.literal: Third month, on guisi day, Xu, grand preceptor and prince of Xiangcheng, was made grand marshal; Gao Yue, equal in honor to the Three Excellencies with open office, was made grand preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guisi day, Xu, grand preceptor and prince of Xiangcheng, was made grand marshal; Gao Yue, equal in honor to the three excellencies with open office, was made grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以冬春亢旱，赦罪人各有差。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, because of severe drought through winter and spring, criminals were pardoned in graded measure.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, because of severe drought through winter and spring, criminals were pardoned in graded measure.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲子，吏部令史張永和、青州人崔闊等偽假人官，事覺，糾檢，首者六萬餘人。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, on jiazi day, Masters of Writing clerks Zhang Yonghe of the Ministry of Personnel and Cui Kuo of Qing province and others falsely assumed offices; when the affair was exposed and investigated, those implicated numbered more than sixty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiazi day, Zhang Yonghe, a Ministry of Personnel clerk, Cui Kuo of Qing province, and others had falsely assumed offices; when the affair was exposed, more than sixty thousand were implicated.

sentences.zh: 秋八月甲戌，[23]以尚書左僕射慕容紹宗為大行臺，與太尉高岳、司徒韓軌、大都督劉豐等討王思政於潁川，引洧水灌其城。

translations.literal: [23] Eighth month of autumn, on jiaxu day, Murong Shaozong, left vice director of the Masters of Writing, was made grand mobile office; together with Grand Preceptor Gao Yue, Minister of Education Han Gui, Grand Commander Liu Feng, and others he campaigned against Wang Sizheng at Yingchuan and led the Wei River to flood the city.
translations.idiomatic: [23] In the eighth month of autumn, on jiaxu day, Murong Shaozong, left vice director of the Masters of Writing, was made grand mobile office; with Gao Yue, grand preceptor, Han Gui, minister of education, Liu Feng, grand commander, and others he attacked Wang Sizheng at Yingchuan and diverted the Wei River to flood the city.

sentences.zh: 九月乙酉，蕭衍遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on yiyou day, Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yiyou day, Xiao Yan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊申，侯景濟江，推蕭衍弟子臨賀王正德為主，以攻建業。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, on wushen day, Hou Jing crossed the Yangzi, set up Xiao Yan's younger brother's son Prince Zhengde of Linhe as ruler, and attacked Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wushen day, Hou Jing crossed the Yangzi, set up Prince Zhengde of Linhe, a nephew of Xiao Yan, as ruler, and attacked Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 是歲，高麗、室韋、蠕蠕、吐谷渾國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Koguryo, Shiwei, Rouran, and Tuyuhun all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Koguryo, Shiwei, Rouran, and Tuyuhun all sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月戊辰，蕭衍弟子北徐州刺史、封山侯蕭正表以鍾離內屬，[24]封蘭陵郡開國公、吳郡王。

translations.literal: [24] Spring, first month of the seventh year, on wuchen day, Xiao Yan's younger brother's son Xiao Zhengbiao, regional inspector of North Xuzhou and Marquis of Fengshan, submitted Zhongli; he was enfeoffed Duke of Lanling commandery with open state and Prince of Wu commandery.
translations.idiomatic: [24] In the first month of spring in the seventh year, on wuchen day, Xiao Zhengbiao, a nephew of Xiao Yan, regional inspector of North Xuzhou and marquis of Fengshan, submitted Zhongli and was enfeoffed duke of Lanling commandery with open state and prince of Wu commandery.

sentences.zh: 三月丁卯，侯景克建業，還以蕭衍為主。

translations.literal: Third month, on dingmao day, Hou Jing took Jiankang and again set up Xiao Yan as ruler.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingmao day, Hou Jing took Jiankang and again set up Xiao Yan as ruler.

sentences.zh: 衍弟子北兗州刺史、定襄侯蕭祗，相譚侯蕭退來降。

translations.literal: Xiao Yan's younger brother's son Zhi, regional inspector of North Yanzhou and Marquis of Dingxiang, and Tui, Marquis of Xiangtan, came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi, a nephew of Xiao Yan, regional inspector of North Yanzhou and marquis of Dingxiang, and Tui, marquis of Xiangtan, came to surrender.

sentences.zh: 衍江北郡國皆內屬。

translations.literal: All commanderies and states north of the Yangzi in Xiao Yan's realm submitted.
translations.idiomatic: All commanderies and states north of the Yangzi in Xiao Yan's realm submitted.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，大行臺慕容紹宗、大都督劉豐遇暴風，溺水死。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer: Grand Mobile Office Murong Shaozong and Grand Commander Liu Feng met a violent storm and drowned.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer Grand Mobile Office Murong Shaozong and Grand Commander Liu Feng met a violent storm and drowned.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔以齊文襄王為相國、齊王，綠綟綬，讚拜不名，入朝不趨，劍履上殿，食冀州之勃海、長樂、安德、武邑，瀛州之河間五郡，邑十五萬戶，餘如故。

translations.literal: On jiachen day an edict made Prince of Qi Wenxiang chancellor and Prince of Qi, with green sash and ribbon, praise at bowing without naming him, no quick step on entering court, sword and shoes in the hall, and fief over five commanderies of Ji and Ying provinces totaling one hundred fifty thousand households; the rest remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day an edict made Prince of Qi Wenxiang chancellor and prince of Qi, with green sash and ribbon, praise at bowing without naming him, no quick step in court, sword and shoes in the hall, and fief over five Ji and Ying commanderies totaling one hundred fifty thousand households; all else stood unchanged.

sentences.zh: 王固讓。

translations.literal: The prince firmly declined.
translations.idiomatic: The prince firmly declined.

sentences.zh: 是月，侯景殺蕭衍，立子綱為主。

translations.literal: That month Hou Jing killed Xiao Yan and set up his son Gang as ruler.
translations.idiomatic: That month Hou Jing killed Xiao Yan and set up his son Gang as ruler.

sentences.zh: 五月，齊文襄王帥眾自鄴赴潁川。

translations.literal: Fifth month: Prince of Qi Wenxiang led troops from Ye to Yingchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Prince of Qi Wenxiang led troops from Ye to Yingchuan.

sentences.zh: 六月丙申，克潁州，擒寶炬大將軍、尚書左僕射、東道大行臺、太原郡開國公王思政，潁州刺史皇甫僧顯等，及戰士一萬餘人，男女數萬口。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on bingshen day, Ying province was taken; Baoju's grand general, left vice director of the Masters of Writing, eastern-route grand mobile office, and Duke of Taiyuan commandery with open state Wang Sizheng, Ying provincial inspector Huangfu Sengxian, and others were captured, together with more than ten thousand fighting men and tens of thousands of men and women.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingshen day, Ying province fell; Wang Sizheng, Baoju's grand general, left vice director of the Masters of Writing, eastern-route grand mobile office, and duke of Taiyuan commandery with open state, Huangfu Sengxian, Ying provincial inspector, and others were captured with more than ten thousand fighting men and tens of thousands of civilians.

sentences.zh: 齊文襄王遂如洛州。
